details.selection_rule: Target conditions are those with declared domain loading >= domain_loading_threshold on the requested target domain. Every successor observation, at every source and effort, in every family that contains at least one target condition is removed from training (family closure). Default 0.25 is required and matches the production domain-cell gate n_sk and the planned 1.5.0 successor-domain holdout. Conditions below the threshold that are pulled in only by family grouping are held out from training but tagged family_closure, not silently scored as primary target conditions. Remaining successor cross-loadings on non-closed families are recorded and are not described as zero evidence.
details.primary_scoring_rule: Primary scoring uses only successor observations on conditions with declared loading >= domain_loading_threshold (lock draft steps 1–3: identify targets at 0.25, remove every successor family row, score only the target conditions). family_closure rows are removed from training with the family but are not the default prediction/scoring set. held_out_observations is the training-removal union, not the primary score.
